settings.aboutLead: LET is a local family business offering guided tours in Lanzarote. We focus on the experience, and the excursion is the means by which we achieve our goal: your satisfaction.
settings.aboutText:
This allows us to monitor quality by offering excursions in small groups, in our own minibuses and in Spanish only.

Lanzarote (a Biosphere Reserve) has a landscape unlike anywhere else in the world, and visitors often feel as though they have landed on another planet. The island is known for its silence, tranquillity, the warm welcome of its people and a volcanic landscape masterfully shaped by artists such as César Manrique and Jesús Soto.

We organise guided tours directly, without intermediaries, in Spanish and in small groups (maximum 14 people). We pick you up at the door of your accommodation.

settings.excursionsTitle: Activities and guided excursions in Lanzarote
settings.excursionsIntro: Excursions, activities and guided tours for discovering the best of Lanzarote in small groups and in Spanish only.
settings.excursionsText:

Each route is designed so you can enjoy Timanfaya, Jameos del Agua, César Manrique's work and the island's less crowded corners, with plenty of time and clear explanations.

settings.blogText:

settings.cruiseHeadline: Shore excursions in the Canary Islands
settings.cruiseIntro: Make the most of your cruise call in Lanzarote (2026–2027 season, Puerto de Los Mármoles) and discover the island on excursions tailored to your all-aboard time.
settings.cruiseText:
We design shore excursions around the actual time available during your call: pickup at the pier, a tour of the essential sights and return to the ship with time to spare.

Check the cruise calendar, choose your cruise line and book the excursion that best fits your all-aboard time.
settings.transferIntro: Spend more time enjoying the island and less time at the airport by booking a private transfer to your hotel. Our driver will be waiting for you in the arrivals terminal.
settings.transferText:
We offer private door-to-door transfers between Lanzarote Airport (ACE) and the main tourist resorts: Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, Costa Teguise, Puerto Calero and more.

You can book a one-way arrival transfer, a one-way departure transfer or a return transfer. The price is per vehicle (not per person), and the driver will be waiting with a sign bearing your name.

If your flight is delayed, we adjust your pickup time. Give us your flight number and hotel when booking for a stress-free arrival.

que-ver-en-lanzarote-en-un-dia.title: What to See in Lanzarote in One Day (If You Arrive by Cruise Ship)
que-ver-en-lanzarote-en-un-dia.excerpt: If your ship calls at Arrecife or Puerto de Los Mármoles, this is your roadmap for seeing the essentials without getting back late for boarding.
que-ver-en-lanzarote-en-un-dia.content:
Arriving in Lanzarote by cruise ship is a golden opportunity… and the clock is ticking. With around 6–8 hours ashore, you can see the island's most iconic sights without rushing if you choose wisely.

**Option A — Half day (Southern Route)**
Timanfaya, El Golfo and La Geria. Perfect if your port call is short or you want to return to the ship with time to spare.

**Option B — Full day (Grand Tour)**
Add Jameos del Agua and the Cactus Garden. The most comprehensive option if you have a long port call.

**Pro tip:** book a private tour or minibus if you are travelling as a family or group. We adapt the departure and return times to your cruise schedule.

At Lanzarote Travels, we arrange pickup at the port and get you back with plenty of time before boarding.
que-ver-en-lanzarote-en-un-dia.author: Lanzarote Travels Team

timanfaya-consejos-practicos.title: Timanfaya: Practical Tips for Your Visit
timanfaya-consejos-practicos.excerpt: Geothermal heat, the Route of the Volcanoes and queues: what you need to know before entering Timanfaya National Park.
timanfaya-consejos-practicos.content:
Timanfaya National Park is the volcanic heart of Lanzarote. Here are the essentials:

**Priority access**
With authorised transport (our minibuses and tours), you avoid long waits during the high season.

**Clothing**
Bring a jacket. Even if it is sunny on the coast, the park is often windy.

**Camels**
The ride is optional and paid for on site.

**Photos**
Islote de Hilario and El Golfo are hard to beat: do not forget your camera.

For the most comfortable experience, choose a small-group or private tour.
timanfaya-consejos-practicos.author: Lanzarote Travels Team

grupo-reducido-vs-grupo-grande.title: Small Group or Large Group: Which Is Right for You?
grupo-reducido-vs-grupo-grande.excerpt: The same itinerary, a different experience. We help you choose according to your travel style and budget.
grupo-reducido-vs-grupo-grande.content:
At Lanzarote Travels, we offer the same routes in two formats:

**Small group (max. 8)**
More personal attention from the guide, a flexible pace and ideal for couples and families who value peace and quiet. The price is slightly higher.

**Large group (up to 20)**
The same route at a better price. You can pay by card, Bizum or on the day of the tour. Perfect if you are travelling on a tighter budget.

There is no “better” option: it depends on whether you prioritise a more intimate experience or price. Lanzarote's landscape is spectacular either way.
grupo-reducido-vs-grupo-grande.author: Lanzarote Travels Team

traslados-aeropuerto-lanzarote.title: Airport Transfers: How to Arrive Stress-Free
traslados-aeropuerto-lanzarote.excerpt: Playa Blanca, Puerto del Carmen, Costa Teguise and more: fixed rates, a sign with your name and flight tracking.
traslados-aeropuerto-lanzarote.content:
After a flight, the last thing you want is to negotiate prices or look for a taxi. A private transfer gives you peace of mind from the very first minute.

**How it works**
We wait for you in the terminal with a sign bearing your name, help you with your luggage and take you straight to your hotel.

**Popular destinations**
Playa Blanca, Puerto Calero, Puerto del Carmen, Arrecife and Costa Teguise — one way, return, or both ways.

**The advantage**
A fixed rate agreed when you book. No surprises due to traffic or late-night schedules.

You can book your transfer online through our website in just a few minutes.
traslados-aeropuerto-lanzarote.author: Lanzarote Travels Team

la-geria-vino-volcanico.title: La Geria: the Volcanic Wine Landscape
la-geria-vino-volcanico.excerpt: Ash hollows, stone walls and Malvasía: why La Geria is an essential stop on almost all our tours.
la-geria-vino-volcanico.content:
La Geria is one of Europe's most remarkable agricultural landscapes. The vines grow in hollows protected from the wind by crescent-shaped volcanic-stone walls.

**What you will see**
Unique panoramic views, wineries and often a small tasting of local wine, depending on the tour.

**When it is visited**
It is included in both the Southern Route and the Grand Tour: a perfect contrast after Timanfaya.

If you would like to enjoy wine tourism at a leisurely pace, ask about a private tour: we can extend the stop at whichever winery you like best.
la-geria-vino-volcanico.author: Lanzarote Travels Team

excursion-sur-de-lanzarote-parque-nacion.title: Southern Lanzarote and Timanfaya National Park Excursion
excursion-sur-de-lanzarote-parque-nacion.summary: Timanfaya National Park, El Golfo, Los Hervideros and La Geria. Ideal for cruise calls (approx. 5 hours), with guaranteed return to the ship.
excursion-sur-de-lanzarote-parque-nacion.description:
Enjoy a tour that takes you to the lunar landscape of Timanfaya National Park, the El Golfo volcano with its green lagoon, the cliffs of Los Hervideros and the La Geria wine region.

We will reach Timanfaya National Park, where you will witness geothermal demonstrations revealing temperatures between 50 and 600°C just a few metres below the surface.

We then continue to the coast to visit Los Hervideros and the El Golfo volcano, with its almost fluorescent green lake. We finish in La Geria, where vines are grown in hollows protected from the wind.

Important information:
• Departure: half an hour after the cruise ship arrives
• Meeting point: port police checkpoint
• Transport: external car park (approx. 10-minute walk)
• Activity level: moderate
• Duration: 5 hours
• Not suitable for people with reduced mobility
